description:
Create a flood observation layer in a project and wait for its map layer.

A flood observation layer holds real flood evidence (Flood marks, Timed
levels, Gauge records, Dry points) that every historic run is compared
with (Compare with observations). It is project-level: it is never a scenario input.
POSTs /projects/<id>/flood-observations/, then polls the layer until its
GeoServer layer exists (`ready`), usually a few seconds; until then
add_observations refuses. On `timed_out`, call list_observations later.

datum_offset_m.description: Metres ADDED to every stage on the layer to bring it onto the terrain datum. Required for vertical_datum=local; null means 0 otherwise

timeout_seconds.description: How long to wait for the map layer (clamped to 280)

vertical_datum.description: The datum the layer's stages are on: terrain (default, 'Same as terrain'), local ('Local datum (constant offset)', needs datum_offset_m), or the vertical datum the levels were surveyed on: an EPSG vertical CRS (e.g. 'EPSG:5703') or the datum's own name (at most 32 characters). Ask the user; never assume one from the country

name: create_observation_layer
title: Create a flood observation layer
